node.title: Rank-eleven component mass enters one fixed populated target
node.closure: fixed-chart lane classification, nine-cell pair-core forcing, and rank-eight error-span reduction
node.statement: The fixed nine-subset concentrator yields at least 2578110 records in one typed component lane. A dominant kernel lane gives one fixed nonzero ambient evaluation kernel. A dominant affine-owner lane has nine-subset evaluation rank eight or nine: rank nine exceeds the 1434405 nine-cell plane cap and forces a shared 134944-coordinate pair core, while rank eight places all selected owners in one U^2 flat and all selected errors in affine rank at most three. These are structural targets, not aggregate payments.
